<h2>Fly in for the wind. We sort out the rest.</h2>
<p>Famara is one of the best kite spots in Europe: a six-kilometre sandy beach with no rocks and no reefs, steady wind for much of the year and a kite zone of its own at the far end of the bay. The Kite Camp puts everything into one booking — the course, all the equipment and a private room in our surf &amp; kite house in Caleta de Famara — so you land, drop your bag and get on with learning.</p>
<p>Your instructor is certified and a qualified lifeguard, every student wears a helmet at every lesson, and you always ride the school’s gear, matched to your level. You meet at our shop in the village, pick up wetsuit and helmet, and drive out to the kite zone together.</p>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-section rs-packages rs-tS" id="kite_packages"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><h2 class="rs-vh rs-c ">Kite Camp Packages</h2></div><div class="rs-vc rs-card" style="--w:4"><figure class="rs-vfig rs-c rs-card__img"><img width="725" height="1024" src="https://www.redstarsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/kite-lessons-card-helmet-725x1024.webp" class="rs-vimg" alt="Kitesurf student in a helmet holding the kite bar on Famara beach, Lanzarote" loading="lazy" decoding="async" sizes="auto, (max-width:900px) 100vw, 50vw" srcset="https://www.redstarsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/kite-lessons-card-helmet-725x1024.webp 725w, https://www.redstarsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/kite-lessons-card-helmet-213x300.webp 213w, https://www.redstarsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/kite-lessons-card-helmet-100x141.webp 100w, https://www.redstarsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/kite-lessons-card-helmet-53x75.webp 53w, https://www.redstarsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/kite-lessons-card-helmet-640x904.webp 640w, https://www.redstarsurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/kite-lessons-card-helmet.webp 765w" /></figure><h3 class="rs-vh rs-c rs-card__title">Try-Out Week</h3><div class="rs-prose ">

<h2>How a kite day works</h2>
<p>Kitesurfing follows the wind and the tide, so there is no fixed timetable: we contact you a few days before your course and confirm the times day by day. Low tide brings the best learning conditions.</p>
<p>You meet your instructor at the shop, talk through your level, pick up wetsuit and helmet and drive to the kite zone together. Kiting is not allowed in front of the village — the zone is the far part of the beach, past the Famara bungalows, where there is room for everyone.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Day 1</strong> — kite control on the sand: safety systems, the wind window, launching and landing</li>
<li><strong>Day 2</strong> — your first body drags in the water and sharper kite control</li>
<li><strong>Days 3–5</strong> — kite and body control together, into the water with the board, and your first rides</li>
</ul>
<p>How quickly it clicks depends on your fitness, the conditions and how much you practise. After three to five days in a row we recommend a rest day — your arms will thank you.</p>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-section rs-tW"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><div class="rs-prose ">
<h2>If the wind does not show up</h2>
<p>Famara’s wind does not follow a calendar, and we would rather say it up front. If there is no usable wind during your stay, you surf instead: the missed kite days are replaced by the same number of surf lessons, and we refund the price difference between the two. It is written in our terms, not improvised at the counter.</p>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-section rs-tS"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><div class="rs-prose ">
<h2>Where you stay</h2>
<p>Kite Camp guests stay in the same surf houses as our Surf Camp: a private room, a fully equipped shared kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, bed linen and towels, and the room cleaned every day. Everything in Caleta de Famara is walkable — the beach, the shop, the restaurants. The airport is 25 to 35 minutes away by car; we do not run an airport transfer.</p>
<p>Prefer your own flat or a bungalow? Book the kite course on its own and see <a href="/accommodation-in-caleta-de-famara-lanzarote/">where to stay in Famara</a>.</p>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-section rs-tW"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><div class="rs-prose ">
<h2>Kite Camp or Surf Camp?</h2>
<p>Same houses, same village, different sport. If you want to learn on the waves, the <a href="/surfcamp/">Surf Camp</a> gives you five lesson days a week with board and wetsuit. If the wind is your thing, stay here. Travelling with someone who surfs while you kite? Book one Kite Camp and one Surf Camp for the same dates.</p>
<p>Only want lessons? See our <a href="/kitesurf-lessons-famara-lanzarote-canary-islands/">kitesurf lessons</a> — group, semi-private and private.</p>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-faqx rs-section rs-faq rs-tS"><div class="rs-w rs-faqx__g"><div class="rs-faqx__l"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><h2 class="rs-vh rs-c ">Frequently asked questions</h2><div class="rs-vraw "><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Do I need any kite experience?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. The Try-Out Week is made for complete beginners. If you have already had lessons, the Level-Up Week picks you up at your level and takes you towards riding on your own.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>What happens if there is no wind?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"><p>Missed kite days are replaced by the same number of surf lessons, and we refund the price difference between the two.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>How many hours a day are on the water?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"><p>Three hours of kiting a day in the Try-Out and Level-Up weeks. The exact times change with the wind and the tide; we confirm them with you day by day.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>On which days are the lessons?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"><p>The Try-Out Week includes 3 lessons and the Level-Up Week 5 lessons per 7 nights; on a Short Trip you have a lesson every day except arrival and departure. The exact days and times are not fixed in advance: when you arrive, your instructor gets in touch, you meet and set them together – at the shop you’re told which day, where and when, because it all depends on the wind and the tide.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>What should I bring?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"><p>Swimwear, sun cream, water and a towel. Kite, board, harness, wetsuit and helmet are provided — kite students always use the school’s gear.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>Do I get a certificate?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"><p>Yes — a kite certificate is included in the Try-Out and Level-Up weeks, and the Level-Up Week comes with a T-shirt too.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>How do I get to Famara?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"><p>Fly to Lanzarote (ACE). Caleta de Famara is 25 to 35 minutes from the airport by car, depending on traffic. We do not offer an airport transfer, so most guests rent a car or take a taxi.</p>
</div></details></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-endcta rs-final-cta"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:8"><h2 class="rs-vh ">Ready to fly?</h2><div class="rs-prose "><p>Pick your package and your dates — see you on the beach in Famara.</p>
</div></div><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:4"><div class="rs-vbtn rs-c"><a class="rs-btn rs-btn--red rs-btn--block" href="https://bookings.redstarsurf.com/en/category/kite-camp-packages?utm_source=redstarsurf&#038;utm_medium=kitecamp&#038;utm_campaign=final" target="_blank" rel="noopener" id="cta_final">Book your Kite Camp</a></div></div></div></section></p>
